## 主张 Claim

16位参与者的公开记录支持有限阶段内的平均反应保留，并限制简单时间曲线的预测适用范围；较复杂模型没有普遍胜出。 / Public records from 16 participants support finite mean response retention and constrain the predictive scope of simple temporal curves; greater model complexity is not uniformly superior.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 采用作者提供的施力补偿系数、FieldA方向及实际试次；作者的完整原始处理未被独立精确重建。 / Use the author-provided force-compensation coefficient, FieldA direction and actual trials; the complete original processing has not been independently reproduced exactly.
- 两组各8人；以参与者为重采样单位，最后50次观察仅用于预测评分；该次分析已知论文结论，属探索性复算。 / Eight participants per group; resample participants and reserve final 50 observations for scoring. Published findings were known, making this exploratory secondary analysis.
- 描述性曲线、基线及外推规则明示；非负水平约束是保留原结果后的事后敏感性分析。 / Descriptive curves, baseline and extrapolation rules are explicit; the nonnegative-level constraint is a post hoc sensitivity preserving the original results.

2,656次有效通道反应连接实际施力与有限保留；其系数不直接等于隐藏记忆、完整理解或Lean追踪误差。 / 2,656 measured channel responses connect actual force with finite retention; their coefficient is not directly hidden memory, full understanding or the Lean tracking error.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

18个来源文件保存；16份MAT核对官方哈希；5,440行、2,656次测量、800次留后预测通过数据与算术检查。实质自审完成，无独立实验、独立agent审查或新Lean定理。 / 18 original files retained; 16 MAT files match deposited hashes; 5,440 rows, 2,656 measurements and 800 held-out predictions pass data and arithmetic checks. Substantive self-review completed; no independent experiment, independent-agent review or new Lean theorem.

未建立无限时间极限、独占机制、完整情境理解、伦理收敛或跨尺度生物联合验证。 / Does not establish an infinite-time limit, unique mechanism, complete situational understanding, ethical convergence or joint cross-scale biological validation.

- 基线校正后的组间区间包含零；自发组简单衰减、诱发组恒定均值的平均预测误差最低。近单位参数不可识别及施力复算差异均保留。 / The baseline-corrected group-difference interval includes zero; simple decay wins mean spontaneous forecast error and a constant mean wins evoked error. Near-unit parameter instability and force reconstruction differences are retained.
